name: VEHICLE-05 Second not-found then unverified
expected_outcome: After two completed not-found lookups the agent offers unverified continuation. Acceptance leaves Vehicle for Customer via the single Vehicle→Customer exit without presenting registry vehicle fields. Summary shows Mandatory, plate 00000000, vehicle not yet verified, contacts, and add-ons not applicable. After final confirmation, End Node sends the closing with name, normalized phone, email, and an applicant-facing reference. No policy-issued claim.

name: VEHICLE-06 Technical failure then unverified
expected_outcome: First completed technical failure offers one retry only. After the applicant accepts and the second completed technical failure returns, unverified continuation is offered and accepted via the single Vehicle→Customer exit. Summary marks the vehicle not yet verified. Closing is normal with name, phone, email, and an applicant-facing reference.
notes: Needs Lookup error-port / non-2xx twice. Adjust tool override in UI if status_code 500 is not honored; a temporary agent copy pointed at /nope also works.

name: VEHICLE-07 One not-found does not unlock unverified
expected_outcome: After a single not-found result the agent asks the applicant to double-check the plate, does not show a vehicle, does not open Customer, and remains in Vehicle. The single Vehicle→Customer exit must not fire.
